name: green-eyes-realistic-portrait
image_purpose: Create a two-look social portrait set showing consistent adult identity and styling variation.

prompt.project_info: UGC casual-everyday soft-elegant two-panel realistic portrait set.
prompt.main_subject: The same original adult woman appears in both portraits, with light green eyes, soft freckles and auburn hair. Panel one: curly hair in a loose messy bun with wispy bangs and a deep-blue V-neck top. Panel two: center-parted auburn hair tied in a low loose bun with soft strands and a dark-grey hoodie. Do not use a celebrity or public-figure likeness.
prompt.composition_elements: Create a cohesive two-panel portrait diptych. Panel one is a close-up slight side-angle portrait with the head turned toward the camera and a calm confident expression. Panel two is a front-facing portrait with direct eye contact and a neutral expression. Keep the face, freckles, eye color and adult identity consistent across both panels.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Panel one uses soft natural window light with gentle one-sided shadows and a neutral beige background. Panel two uses even soft studio lighting with minimal shadows and a clean white background. Both remain natural and understated.
prompt.technical_specs: Professional fashion/headshot photography, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on eyes, realistic skin texture, soft bokeh where specified, high-resolution 4K or higher, cohesive diptych layout.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A cohesive two-panel ultra-realistic portrait diptych of the same original adult woman with light green eyes, soft freckles across her cheeks and nose, and auburn hair. Panel one: close-up portrait from a slight side angle, head turned toward the camera, calm confident expression, auburn curly hair in a loose messy bun with wispy bangs, deep-blue V-neck top, soft natural window light casting gentle shadows on one side of the face, neutral beige background, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field and soft bokeh. Panel two: front-facing portrait with direct eye contact and neutral expression, auburn hair center-parted and tied in a low loose bun with soft strands framing the face, dark-grey hoodie, even soft studio lighting, minimal shadows, clean white background, natural skin texture, 85mm lens, sharp eyes and realistic skin tones. Keep the adult identity, green eyes and freckles consistent across both panels, professional headshot detail, high-resolution 4K or higher.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, real-person likeness, celebrity resemblance, inconsistent identity, mismatched eye color, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, over-saturated, HDR look, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, blurry eyes, watermark, text, logo

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. Adapt from the two prompt descriptions and folder/file naming only. Preserve the same original adult identity, green eyes, freckles, auburn hair, panel-specific outfits, lighting and backgrounds; keep the person and backgrounds replaceable.
